mutations.remove: Keep candidates seen in at least two distinct root sessions, or label a high-severity single-session finding.

Require at least two real occurrences of the same obstacle, on one item or
   across matching items, with a shared improvement target.

After an improvement ships, check whether the friction recurred. This reports
historical occurrences; it does not establish that the issue is still present.
When proposing solutions, include an option that simplifies by removing one of these:
Keep friction in `<store dir>/friction.jsonl`, the source of truth; `learn.db` is a rebuildable cache.
